Thanks Elena — welcoming TidalTech onboard. I reviewed the bank letter and the W9, all good for ACH. Notes below:

- ACH remit text: Redwood will populate the ACH Addenda/Trace with "RDW-PO:<PONUMBER>" using the PO we receive on the invoice. Please ensure your invoices include the exact PO string in the invoice_reference field so it maps automatically.
- Micro-deposit: we'll send two micro-deposits summing to an amount between $0.10 and $0.99 to confirm the account. Expect the deposits within 48 hours once you confirm the company legal name matches the bank record.
- Remit CSV: I've attached our current remit sample (remit_csv_sample.csv). Key headers we require: payout_id, payout_date, payee_name, payee_account_last4, po_reference, invoice_total_usd, remit_note. If your AP system expects a different order, please send a sample mapping.
- DocuSign: for faster payments we require a signed payment authorization form. I'll send it via DocuSign after micro-deposit completes.

Attachments: remit_csv_sample.csv (csv)

Next steps: Elena to confirm legal name on bank account and ack micro-deposit; we'll trigger micro-deposits and DocuSign link.

Best,
